rule: median craft score within 1 of the exemplar, and a memorable moment named by most critics, in every trial

per.memorable: the scrub line sweeping across the day and the wind bars turning amber behind it
the red scan line sweeping the day and the wind bars turning amber behind it

corrections.problem: the answer (leave 08:30, home 14:10) appears last and is held under 1s before the loop restarts
corrections.change: land the plan times by 4.0s and hold the finished card at least 2.5s before any reset
corrections.keep: the scan sweep as the climax

corrections.problem: window box is drawn while the label still says 'Not checked'
corrections.change: flip each row's label in the same frame its window box lands, Out then Back about 0.1s apart
corrections.keep: the pink window boxes growing in place

corrections.where: A 3.5s to 5.0s, header, button, rows, plan
corrections.problem: updates scatter across the card so nothing owns the screen
corrections.change: sequence them as one chain from the bars downward: rows, then plan, then header status, each about 0.1s to 0.15s apart
corrections.keep: in-place text changes with no cuts

corrections.problem: an empty white card with ghost labels shows for 0.3s, reads as loading
corrections.change: start with the chart already drawn and begin on the button press
corrections.keep: the top to bottom row fill order

per.memorable: the scrub line sweeping the day and wind bars turning amber behind it

corrections.problem: tide, stream, wind and light all appear in one 0.2s step, nothing tells the eye where to start
corrections.change: reveal rows top to bottom with about 0.08s offsets, tide first, total under 0.5s
corrections.keep: the empty card frame appearing first

corrections.problem: 08:30, 10:10, 12:30, 14:10 arrive with under a second before the clip ends; they cannot be read aloud
corrections.change: start the plan fill by 4.2s and hold the finished card at least 2.5s
corrections.keep: the plan filling after the windows, as their consequence

corrections.where: A 1.70s to 2.60s, scrub line and the cursor
corrections.problem: the cursor sits on the button while the line sweeps; two moving things compete
corrections.change: move the cursor off or fade it as the sweep starts so the sweep owns the screen
corrections.keep: the sweep speed and the amber bars trailing it

corrections.where: A 3.00s to 4.00s, Out and Back window boxes
corrections.problem: the windows appear with a near cut and the status 'Not checked' flips to times in the same frame
corrections.change: grow each window box from the sweep position over about 0.25s with an ease out, Out first then Back 0.1s later, then update the times text
corrections.keep: the pink window boxes and their placement

per.memorable: the scrub line sweeping the day before the windows drop in

corrections.problem: label disappears and the button shows as an empty magenta pill for a frame or two
corrections.change: crossfade 'Checking' to the next label in place with overlap so a label is always legible
corrections.keep: the button never moving or resizing

corrections.where: A 3.44s to 3.94s, scrub line and windows
corrections.problem: the sweep, the amber bars and two windows all resolve inside half a second so nothing owns the screen
corrections.change: let the sweep finish, pause 0.2s, then land the Out and Back windows 0.1s apart
corrections.keep: the 0.1s offset between Out and Back

corrections.problem: the actual answer (08:30, 10:10, 12:30, 14:10) arrives last and quietly at the bottom
corrections.change: fill the plan values with a short in-place roll and keep the cursor and everything else still while it lands
corrections.keep: the ordering, plan after windows

corrections.problem: the finished card cuts to an empty card
corrections.change: fade the results out in place over 0.3s before the next press
corrections.keep: the empty starting state

corrections.problem: over six seconds of total stillness after a rushed action
corrections.change: spend some of that time slowing the action, then hold the result 3s
corrections.keep: a long final hold on the plan

per.memorable: the scan line passing and the two pink windows dropping into the Out and Back rows

corrections.problem: label fades out to an empty magenta pill before 'Find windows' returns
corrections.change: roll the label in place from 'Checking' to 'Find windows' with no empty frame
corrections.keep: the button keeping its size and position

corrections.where: A 3.74s to 3.94s, Out and Back rows
corrections.problem: window boxes appear while the row labels still read 'Not checked'
corrections.change: write 'Leave 07:33 to 09:30' in the same frame each box lands
corrections.keep: the Out then Back offset

corrections.where: A 4.1s to 5.4s, header and plan row
corrections.problem: '2 windows found' in the top corner and the plan times at the bottom change 1.2s apart in far corners, splitting attention
corrections.change: let the plan row fill straight after the second window lands, then update the header status last and quietly
corrections.keep: the long final hold

corrections.problem: full result cuts to an empty, unchecked state
corrections.change: fade results out in reverse order over 0.4s before the cursor returns
corrections.keep: the cursor press as the start of the action

per.memorable: the sweep line passing and the windows appearing behind it

corrections.problem: the clip starts on the answer and then cuts to a blank plan, which reads as a glitch and spoils the payoff
corrections.change: start on the unchecked state, or crossfade the reset over 0.3s while off the reader's focus
corrections.keep: the looping structure

corrections.problem: press state and label change to Checking happen in one frame with the cursor covering the label
corrections.change: show a 0.1s press scale, then let the label change with the cursor already moving away
corrections.keep: the cursor click as the trigger

corrections.problem: 'Ready to check' blinks to empty and then '2 windows found' while the windows land at the same moment, two reading targets at once
corrections.change: land the windows first, then change the header 0.1 to 0.15s later in place
corrections.keep: the wording '2 windows found'

corrections.problem: 6s of still frame after a crowded 4s; time is spent where nothing happens
corrections.change: spread the click, sweep and plan fill across 1s to 7s and hold the result 3 to 4s
corrections.keep: the order click, sweep, windows, plan

per.memorable: the window losing 25 minutes and its times rolling to the new values

corrections.problem: old and new notifications crossfade on top of each other so both 'Halyard' rows and both messages are unreadable
corrections.change: slide the old notification out (or fade it fully) before the new one rises into the same slot, or roll the content inside one card
corrections.keep: the notification staying in the same corner and size

corrections.where: A 6.90s to 7.50s, window bar and 'Leave' label
corrections.problem: the bar trims about 0.6s before the time label updates, so the screen briefly disagrees with itself
corrections.change: start the label roll within 0.1s of the bar trim
corrections.keep: the hatched trim on the bar end

corrections.problem: the trigger is a small pill top right that changes color with little emphasis, so the cause is easy to miss
corrections.change: give the forecast change a brief in-place roll and a 0.3s hold before the window reacts
corrections.keep: the order: forecast, then window, then notification

corrections.problem: first notification enters with no visible link to the card and sits for 3s as a side note
corrections.change: shorten its stay or tie it to a visible save action
corrections.keep: the timestamp in the notification

per.memorable: the forecast changing and the return window shrinking by 25 minutes in place, with each number rolling after it

corrections.problem: old and new toast text overlap and double-print
corrections.change: push the old toast up and out over 0.15s, then bring the new one in, or roll its text in place
corrections.keep: the toast arriving after the bar and labels have changed

corrections.problem: 3s with nothing moving and no focal point
corrections.change: start the forecast change by 1.5s, or open on the 'Plan saved' toast already present
corrections.keep: the cause first ordering: forecast, bar, labels, toast

corrections.problem: the trimmed 25 minutes is a thin amber hatch that is easy to miss at this size
corrections.change: animate the right edge of the pink box sliding left over about 0.3s with the removed span highlighted
corrections.keep: the change happening in place on the same bar

corrections.problem: the row time rolls almost together with the window label so the two changes compete
corrections.change: offset the row time about 0.15s after the window label
corrections.keep: the vertical digit roll

per.memorable: the window trimming itself with a hatched sliver as the new forecast arrives

corrections.problem: old 'Plan saved' and new 'Back window moved' text are both visible and overlapping, unreadable for those frames
corrections.change: fade or slide the old message fully out in about 0.12s before the new one enters, or roll it vertically in its slot
corrections.keep: the toast staying in the same place and the new wording

corrections.where: A 6.20s to 7.70s, chip, window, times, row and toast
corrections.problem: five changes in 1.5s with no one owning the screen
corrections.change: make the window trim the climax with a 0.3s hold before the text updates, then update the times and the toast together after it
corrections.keep: the cause first order: forecast chip, then window, then text

corrections.problem: the toast arrives and then 3s pass with nothing new; the setup is long relative to the payoff
corrections.change: trim the idle hold to about 1.5s and give the after state at least 3s
corrections.keep: the toast text 'Plan saved. Out 07:33, back 11:10.'

per.memorable: the route drawing across the Solent

corrections.problem: distance and speed read 0.0 while the boat is visibly sailing, so the numbers contradict the map
corrections.change: count distance up with the trace, or hide the stats until arrival and then reveal them in place
corrections.keep: the three-column stats layout

corrections.problem: the arrival values cut in with no motion, so the climax of the trace has no landing
corrections.change: roll 'Leave 08:30' to 'Arrive 10:10' and the numbers in place, 0.1s apart left to right, as the dot reaches Cowes
corrections.keep: the magenta arrival time

corrections.problem: 5.5s trace with a near 1s stall at Yarmouth drags and reads like a hitch
corrections.change: trace in about 2s with one ease, slowing only into Cowes
corrections.keep: the dashed planned route ahead of the solid sailed line

corrections.problem: finished route snaps back to the start
corrections.change: fade the sailed line out over 0.3s before restarting
corrections.keep: the waypoints staying visible

corrections.problem: map tiles wash out for a frame
corrections.change: fix the render or capture so the map never flickers
corrections.keep: the map palette

corrections.problem: distance and speed sit at 0.0 the whole trip, so the numbers say nothing while the boat moves
corrections.change: count distance up with the dot and show elapsed time, landing on 10.5 nm and 10:10 as the dot reaches Cowes
corrections.keep: the 0.1s stagger between the three stats

corrections.problem: the drawn route cuts away and the dot jumps back to the start
corrections.change: fade the trail out over 0.4s, then move the dot back or start from a clean map
corrections.keep: the dashed planned route under the solid sailed route

corrections.problem: the dot halts about 1s at each waypoint, which reads as a stall
corrections.change: ease through waypoints with a slight slow-down, and run the whole leg in about 3s
corrections.keep: the waypoint rings filling as the dot passes

corrections.problem: the 'Leave 08:30' chip does not change when the boat arrives, so the arrival has no climax at the top
corrections.change: land the arrival as one moment: dot reaches Cowes, ring fills, then 'Arrive 10:10' rolls in 0.1s later
corrections.keep: the long final hold of about 3.5s

per.memorable: the route line drawing across the Solent

corrections.where: B 2.50s to 8.20s, Distance sailed and Average speed
corrections.problem: the numbers read 0.0 the whole voyage, so the stats carry no information while the boat moves
corrections.change: count distance up with the dot's progress and settle speed in the last 0.5s, tabular figures so nothing jitters
corrections.keep: the stat labels and their positions

corrections.where: B 8.20s, Leave Lymington to Arrive Cowes
corrections.problem: label, time and both stats change in one cut
corrections.change: when the dot lands, roll the time 08:30 to 10:10 in place and the label with it, 0.1s after the dot settles
corrections.keep: the final values 10:10, 10.5 nm, 6.3 kn

corrections.problem: the drawn route snaps back to empty mid frame, a visible cut
corrections.change: fade the drawn line out over 0.3s after a hold at Cowes, then restart
corrections.keep: the dashed planned route under the drawn one

corrections.problem: linear motion with hard stops at waypoints reads mechanical
corrections.change: ease the dot through waypoints without stopping and ease out into Cowes
corrections.keep: the dot as the only moving thing during the sail

corrections.problem: one frame where the land and water fills smear
corrections.change: fix the render so the map is stable during the hold
corrections.keep: the map colors and labels
